content: अञ्च् €1 <ab>U.</ab> (अञ्चु) (अञ्चति-ते, आनञ्च-ञ्चे, अञ्चितुम्, अच्यात् or अञ्च्यात्, अक्त or अञ्चित) .²1 To bend, incline, curl, curve; शिरोऽञ्चित्वा <ls>Bk. 9. 40</ls>. .²2 To go, move, tend towards; स्वतन्त्रा कथमञ्चसि <ls>Bk. 4. 22</ls>; also in अवाञ्च्; tending downward, प्राञ्च्, उदञ्च्; विश्वगञ्चति, सहाञ्चति, तिरोऽञ्चति <ab>&c.</ab>; तस्मिन्नद्य रसालशाखिनि दशां दैवात् कृशामञ्चति <ls>Bv. 1. 48</ls> having gone, being reduced to, <ab>&c.</ab>; त्वं चेदञ्चसि लोभम् <ls n="Bv. 1.">46</ls>, art greedy; संकोचमञ्चति सरः <ls n="Bv. 1.">17</ls>. .²3 To worship, honour, reverence; भीमोऽयं शिरसाञ्चति <ls>Ve. 5. 28</ls>. salutes; to adorn, grace; see अञ्चित below. .²4 To request, ask or call for, desire. .²5 To murmur, speak indistinctly. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} or €10 <ab>U.</ab> To manifest, unfold; मुदमञ्चय <ls>Gīt. 10</ls>. [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>Zend.</lang> {%anku%}; <lang>Gr.</lang> {%ankulos%}; <lang>L.</lang> {%uncus%}.] With अप to put away, drive away; (intr.) to run away. .{@-आ@} to bend; दक्षिणं जान्वाच्य; जान्वाक with bent knees. .{@-उप@} to draw or raise (water). .{@-परि@} to cause to revolve, whirl, twist. .{@-वि@} to draw or bend asunder; to extend, stretch out. .{@-सम्@} to crowd or drive together, to bend together. See समक्न also; to go properly.
